metadata.description: Generic Claude Code plugins for AI engineering workflows. Sole plugin since v4.0.0: learn-kit — pedagogical kit covering manual 8-stage authoring methodology, AI three-tier learning doc generation with interactive HTML, and NotebookLM multimedia artifact generation (audio/video/slide_deck/infographic × 3 view variants + 1 shared mind_map = up to 13 artifacts per topic; markdown-only sources). v4.1.0 adds 18 project-local mp-* workflow skills under .claude/skills/. v4.2.0+ introduces marketplace documentation framework v1.0: 6 tag prefixes + 8-field frontmatter + 3-state machine + 3 STANDARDs + 2 SPECs + 6 templates; v4.2.1 retrofits 8 existing docs into framework subdirs. v4.3.0 extends framework into plugin-internal docs. v4.4.0 introduces archive mechanism: Documentation Framework v1.2 (§2.3.1-§2.3.4 archive triggers / frontmatter / banner / living-vs-frozen refs) + [RUNBOOK]_Doc_Archive_Procedure.md v1.0 (4-phase workflow + 2 HITL gates); v4.4.x flat archive layout (Framework v1.4 / RUNBOOK v1.1) + HITL STANDARD v1.3 archive integration. v4.5.0 cancels Framework v1.1 §1 exemption mechanism (Framework v1.4 → v1.5; HITL STANDARD v1.3 → v1.4 with universal skeleton §0; learn-kit 1.1.0 → 1.2.0 docs consolidation; 7 superseded docs deleted; marketplace independence principle codified). v5.0.0 BREAKING: learn-kit `init` skill renamed to `scaffold-learning` (plugin 1.2.1 → 2.0.0) to eliminate slash-picker collision with Claude Code's builtin /init; see [ADR]_LearnKit_Init_Skill_Rename.md + Migration_From_v3_to_v4 §5.

plugins.name: learn-kit
plugins.description: Pedagogical kit for learnable knowledge artifacts. Five skills: (1) /learn-kit:scaffold-learning scaffolds the learning subsystem (v2.0.0 renamed from /learn-kit:init to eliminate slash-picker collision with Claude Code builtin /init); (2) /learn-kit:locate reverse-looks up concepts; (3) /learn-kit:scan enumerates learnable docs; (4) /learn-kit:generate-tier AI-generates three-tier (foundation/structural/challenge) learning markdown plus optional interactive HTML; (5) /learn-kit:nlm-studio pushes a topic's three-tier markdown corpus to NotebookLM and generates up to 13 online-viewable multimedia artifacts (4 view-cycled types × 3 views + 1 shared mind_map; markdown-only sources). nlm-studio requires notebooklm-mcp MCP server (bundled) + nlm login; the other four skills run with no external dependencies. v2.0.0 BREAKING: scaffold skill renamed init → scaffold-learning; migrate `/learn-kit:init` calls to `/learn-kit:scaffold-learning`.
